method.baseline: Earlier T2 runs of this change set could not index polyglot or csharp-tinyioc, because the corpus environment named the SDK's bin/dotnet launcher script as the C# execution host and the producer refuses a script it cannot hold in private custody. With the host set to the SDK's ELF muxer, polyglot published 7 complete native profiles and csharp-tinyioc published its native profiles, so these are the first answers this change set produced for both cases.
method.snapshot_diff: Each candidate snapshot printed by T2 was diffed leaf by leaf against the committed snapshot, and every changed text field was compared character by character.
method.typescript-query-core: Only the derived source identity moved since the snapshot accepted in 2026-11-13-typescript-query-core-native-evidence.json. frontends/typescript/build.rs hashes Cargo.toml and Cargo.lock into the TypeScript frontend identity, and the workspace wiring commit changes both files, so the source_root and revision are recomputed values, not answer changes.
